title: Mickelsen Safeguard ABM site and the 1975 UFO wave

tellings.quote: So what had happened in 75 in February they opened what was called the Mickelson Stanley ABM site. It was the only anti-bballistic missile unit that everyone operational in the United States.

plain: In February 1975, according to the UFO researcher Grant Cameron, the Mickelsen Safeguard site opened near Nekoma, North Dakota. He calls it the only anti-ballistic missile unit, a base built to shoot down incoming nuclear missiles, ever to become operational in the United States. Cameron tells Michels this to tie the base to the wave of UFO sightings over American military sites that same year, and he names no source.
